# Synthetic dashboard result

`synthetic-single-result.json` was generated by the public `run_simulation` service
from `build_synthetic_case`, SC, 8 slots, MISOCP, storage enabled, 60-second solve
limit on 2026-09-18. It contains no customer measurements. It is a captured
transport fixture for result identity/UI tests, not a numerical reference oracle.
Tests clone it with a distinct generation time to identify a second completion.

Event-scope tests also construct an explicitly synthetic cluster transport projection
from this fixture: three-region metadata, two small aggregate time points and an
existing event. These values verify target selection and preservation of request/result
identity, not cluster physics or solver accuracy.
